name: Pro Garage
displayDescription:
Access your garage customizations and all of your vehicles ANYWHERE!
- Spawn any vehicle you own! 
- Customize anywhere! 
- Save your favorite customizations! 
- Minimized timers when spawning outside a garage location!

name: VIP Lifetime
displayDescription:
Stand out from the crowd with this pass!
+ Unique chat color so players know who you are!
+ Additional spawn choice on death, unique to VIP!
+ Bonus Contract Re-Rolls!
+ 1 tier-two safe every day!
+ $1,000 daily cash!
+ Instantly unlock Level 4 Police and Criminal bases!
+ 20% more Cash whenever you earn cash, except safe rewards!
+ Chrome Paint garage option!
+ 100 Rocket Fuel per day!
+ 10 total Garage save slots!

name: Crime Boss
displayDescription:
As a crime boss you’ll receive special perks to help battle off the police team. 
- Drive the “Celestial” vehicle with a minigun mounted on top! 
- Gain access to a pinstripe suit with sunglasses, a hooded cloak, and bandana! 
- Receive notifications when a new robbery opens up to 1 minute before other players! 
- Lower visibility on the Minimap to the opposing team!
- Additional spawn choice with parachute while playing Criminal!
- Plus your character will automatically change into normal clothing as soon as you escape the prison!

name: Duffel Bag
displayDescription:
Your Duffel Bag has four possible tiers. Purchase this pass to be taken straight to the top and earn the most cash while robbing most locations as a Criminal! 

If you already own Tier 4, you do not need to purchase this pass. Thank you!

name: SWAT Team
displayDescription:
It's time to dominate! Crack down on criminals with this pass! 
- Earn 20% more cash!
- The SWAT Van!
- View bounties on the go!
- SWAT Clothing, machine gun, black pistols, and riot shield!
- You'll be less seen on maps!
- And an additional spawn choice point with parachute!

name: VIP Trading
displayDescription:
1. [New] Jump across Trade Servers with Server Select!
2. A button on our menu so you can teleport straight to the Trade Hub!
3. [VIP TRADER] chat tag with magenta chat text inside the Trade Hub!
4. Animated RGB trade banners to catch the eyes of other traders!
5. Your trade requests will have a unique look, and stick around longer than others!

Plus special features off-site and more to come. Become a VIP in the Trade Hub today!

name: Car Stereo
displayDescription:
Warning: With the recent Roblox Audio purge, many favorite audios may not work! 

Use any sound you can find in the Roblox catalog, and have it be heard by other players! You'll also gain a stereo in your apartment!

name: XP Boost
displayDescription: Beginning Season 3, level up -50%- quicker while participating in our seasonal events!

name: Extra Storage [Retiring Soon]
displayDescription:
This pass originally offered extra storage space in your jail cell to store items.

Existing owners of the gamepass received some in-game cash, rocket fuel, and a unique vehicle item.
